incumbent.name: Bruce D. Aukerman
incumbent.summary: Bruce D. Aukerman has been Vermillion County prosecutor since January 1, 2011, and sits on the board of directors of the Indiana Prosecuting Attorneys Council {verm_ipac}. He is seeking re-election as the Democratic nominee {in_list}.
record: January 1, 2011: Took office as Vermillion County prosecutor {verm_ipac}.
October 2023: The county announced that the prosecutor's office had received the STOP Violence Against Women grant for the second year in a row {verm_stop}.
The office, based in Newport, lists child support enforcement and victim services among its functions; its staff page lists Noah Gambill as chief deputy prosecutor {verm_office}{verm_staff}.
No 2025–2026 news coverage of the office's caseloads, budget or charging decisions was found in the sources reviewed.

race_context: Incumbent Democrat Bruce D. Aukerman, in office since 2011, faces Republican Jim Organ {in_list}{verm_ipac}.
Both candidates filed during the primary filing period: Organ on January 9, 2026 and Aukerman on January 13, 2026 {in_list}. No May 5, 2026 primary results for this office were found.
